sectors.trend: Sharp deterioration. Iron ore 'bloodletting' underway; oil price surge creates mixed signals for energy miners. Cap raises signal distress among juniors.
sectors.implications: BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX face margin compression. STO.AX and gas names (WDS.AX) benefit from softened supply rules. Small-caps (PolarX, Sunstone, Manuka) show relative strength but elevated dilution risk.

sectors.trend: Under pressure from rising bond yields and rate-hike expectations. ANZ.AX restructuring (3,500 cuts) signals cost discipline but execution risk. NAB.AX, CBA.AX, WBC.AX face net-interest margin headwinds.
sectors.implications: Rate hikes support NIMs but credit risk rises with business confidence deterioration. ANZ.AX grand plan unproven; watch cost-to-income trajectory.

sectors.trend: Oil 'explodes' as suppression fails, but IEA forecasts sharp demand drop. Australian fuel prices +30c. Santos preservation and gas rule easing support domestic energy.
sectors.implications: WDS.AX, STO.AX, AWE.AX benefit from gas policy shift. Oil volatility creates two-way risk for LNG exporters.

sectors.trend: Woolworths (WES.AX) price-freeze breach erodes consumer trust. Housing correction boosts first-home buyers but dampens construction-linked spend.
sectors.implications: WES.AX, CPL.AX face margin pressure from input costs. REITs (GPG.AX, ICPS.AX) pressured by rental inflation and falling property values.

sectors.trend: CSL.AX relatively insulated. AI infrastructure and space stocks (US-listed) show momentum but execution risks flagged. ASX small-caps (Neurizon, Iondrive) see speculative flows.
sectors.implications: Defensive healthcare (CSL.AX, SGH.AX) offers relative safety. Tech small-caps carry high dilution and execution risk.

sectors.trend: Housing correction accelerates; NZ five-year correction still running. Property chiefs call for more migrants to address supply. Auction market flat.
sectors.implications: REITs under pressure from falling valuations. Construction (WBC.AX, CGW.AX) may see delayed demand. Rental inflation supports yield but caps capital growth.

key_themes: Rate-hike fears dominate: RBA rental inflation concern, new Fed Chair hawkish stance, August CPI elevating rate expectations
Commodity bifurcation: iron ore weak, oil volatile, gold range-bound
AUD weakness amplifies import costs and pressures resource exporters' local revenue
Housing correction in advanced stage; policy response (migrants, supply) lagging
Mining sector capital raises signal liquidity stress among juniors
Superannuation system under political and structural scrutiny

risk_assessment.mitigation: Overweight short-duration bonds; reduce leverage; favour fixed-income income streams (JEPI/SCHD-type structures)
Reduce exposure to BHP.AX, RIO.AX, FMG.AX; rotate into gold (GOLD.AX) and gas (WDS.AX)
Hedge FX exposure; favour domestic-revenue companies; monitor AUD/USD 0.62 support

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Oil price volatility / fuel cost pass-through
risk_assessment.mitigation: Monitor WDS.AX, AWE.AX; consumer staples (WES.AX) face margin squeeze from +30c fuel
Underweight property REITs; monitor construction cyclicality; watch first-home buyer data for inflection

risk_assessment.risk_factor: Mining junior dilution / cap raise overhang
risk_assessment.mitigation: Avoid pre-announcement small-caps; favour funded, producing assets

opportunities.recommendation: Overweight gas and LNG names on policy tailwind
opportunities.rationale: Softened local gas supply rules and Santos preservation create structural support for domestic energy

opportunities.recommendation: Defensive healthcare and quality consumer staples
opportunities.rationale: Rate-hike environment and growth scare favour low-beta, dividend-paying names

opportunities.recommendation: Selective gold exposure on rate uncertainty
opportunities.rationale: Gold range-bound but CPI-driven rate expectations create safe-haven bid; Kuniko (NSW gold-silver) offers ASX-listed entry

opportunities.recommendation: Battery tech / critical minerals on policy support
opportunities.rationale: Critical Resources battery tech passes month-long test; structural demand intact

defensive_moves.recommendation: Reduce iron ore / thermal coal exposure
defensive_moves.rationale: Iron ore bloodletting underway; China demand concerns and cap raise overhang signal further downside

defensive_moves.recommendation: Hedge AUD weakness and rate risk
defensive_moves.rationale: AUD smashed on growth scare; RBA rental inflation focus implies tighter policy ahead

defensive_moves.recommendation: Underweight property REITs and construction cyclicals
defensive_moves.rationale: Housing correction not yet bottomed; Leith Van Onselen flags further falls; auction market flat

market_outlook.short_term: Bearish. ASX likely to test lower supports as rate-hike expectations, iron ore weakness, and AUD depreciation compound. Miners and banks remain the drag. Oil volatility adds noise. Expect 3-5% further downside on ^AXJO before stabilisation.
market_outlook.long_term: Cautiously constructive post-correction. Gas policy reform, battery tech maturation, and housing supply response (migrants) offer medium-term structural support. Superannuation reform debate may create policy tailwinds for listed funds. Iron ore recovery contingent on China stimulus.
